entries.name: Lemonade stand
entries.blurb: A table, a jug, and an inflated sense of business.
lines: Ran a lemonade stand all summer and took ${amount}. Overheads were somebody else's problem.
The lemonade stand cleared ${amount}, most of it from one very generous neighbour.

entries.name: Walking a neighbour's dog
entries.blurb: Every day after school, in all weathers.
lines: Walked the neighbour's dog every day after school and made ${amount} doing it.
The dog-walking money came to ${amount} over the year, and the dog liked you best.

entries.name: Washing cars
entries.blurb: Bucket, sponge, and the whole street.
lines: Washed cars up and down the street most weekends and made ${amount}.
Made ${amount} washing cars, and got very good at the wheels nobody else does.

entries.name: Paper round
entries.blurb: Before school. Every morning. In the dark half the year.
lines: Did the paper round all year, in the dark half of it, and made ${amount}.
The paper round paid ${amount} and cost every single morning.

entries.name: Babysitting
entries.blurb: Somebody else's children, after their bedtime.
lines: Babysat most Fridays and made ${amount} watching other people's television.
Babysitting brought in ${amount}, and one family asked for you specifically.

entries.name: Mowing lawns
entries.blurb: Hot work, and the money is real.
lines: Mowed lawns all summer and came out ${amount} up.
Made ${amount} on lawns. Your hands looked like somebody else's by August.

entries.name: Tutoring a younger kid
entries.blurb: An hour a week, explaining what you already know.
lines: Tutored a younger kid all year and made ${amount}, which felt like stealing.
Tutoring paid ${amount}, and the kid actually got better, which was the surprise.

entries.name: Busking
entries.blurb: A pitch, an hour, and whoever walks past.
lines: Played on the street most Saturdays and made ${amount} in a hat.
Busking brought in ${amount}, and somebody filmed you once, which was terrifying.

entries.name: Drawing things for people
entries.blurb: Ten dollars a head, thirty for a pet.
lines: Drew things for people all year and made ${amount} at it.
Took ${amount} in drawing commissions, and got faster than you got better.

entries.name: Weekend shifts in a shop
entries.blurb: A name badge, a till, and a manager called Dave.
lines: Worked weekends in a shop all year and made ${amount}. It was mostly fine.
The weekend job paid ${amount} and took every Saturday you had.

entries.name: Kitchen shifts
entries.blurb: Hot, loud, and the best people you will ever work with.
lines: Worked in a kitchen most nights and made ${amount}. You have never been so tired.
The kitchen paid ${amount} and taught you to work faster than you thought you could.

entries.name: Lifeguarding
entries.blurb: Sun, chlorine, and forty minutes of genuine responsibility.
lines: Lifeguarded all summer and made ${amount} watching people not drown.
Lifeguarding paid ${amount} and cost you an entire summer of being anywhere else.

entries.name: Camp counsellor
entries.blurb: Six weeks, twelve children, no signal.
lines: Did six weeks as a camp counsellor and came back ${amount} up and completely changed.
Camp paid ${amount}, which worked out at about nothing an hour, and was worth it anyway.
